summary: @ornikar/rollup-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmods the binary, and executes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header, shuffled string-array dispatcher, hex-mangled identifiers) whose contents are unreadable without full deobfuscation and have no documented relationship to rollup configuration. setup.mjs itself is also hex-mangled (identifiers of the form _0xNNNN with per-call string-lookup dictionaries wrapping trivial constants like "--version", "utf8", "Alpine"). The @ornikar scope publishes a rollup-config helper with no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque 727 KB payload; the alternate-runtime channel exists to run install-time code that Node-oriented static analysis will not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
